page_identity.identifier_normalization: uppercase the matched identifier; keeps C-88 and C-88A DISTINCT
page_identity.display_title_rule: first_source_occurrence_surface_form: the exact surface text of this anchor's first posting in ascending (document_revision_id, chunk_id, start_char, end_char) order, copied verbatim from source_text/heading_path; never re-worded, never type-prefixed, never generated
page_identity.page_type_rule: the anchor's own anchor_kind; fully deterministic; never model-generated

lane_1_identifier.lifted_from: graph_retrieval_benchmark/model.py identifiers_in (LIFTED, never imported -- Revision 6 Q9)

lane_2_repeated_phrase.run_rule: maximal runs of consecutive QUALIFYING tokens; a stop-listed or non-qualifying token ENDS the run
lane_2_repeated_phrase.identifier_collision_rule: a candidate containing an identifier token is dropped -- identifiers win

lane_3_heading_title.rule: one anchor per distinct normalized heading_path element
lane_3_heading_title.reason: Revision 6 SS7.1 -- a shared heading asserts document-template similarity, not entity co-occurrence

membership_rule.statement: a facet (page_key, document_revision_id) exists IF AND ONLY IF that page identity has >= 1 anchor posting in that revision
membership_rule.authority_effect: an authority change alters VISIBILITY only -- never membership, never a hash

links.structural: document / revision-page / section hierarchy and revision-history siblings; asserts no entity relationship
links.exact_anchor: means ONLY: this same source-backed identity occurs there; no direction, no type, no lineage
links.advisory_downgrade: exact-anchor links of a phrase anchor with pairwise-disjoint identifier context are marked advisory

sentence_splitter.specification: split source_text on blank-line block boundaries, then within each block after a '.', '!' or '?' that is followed by whitespace or end-of-block; spans are half-open over the ORIGINAL text; leading/trailing whitespace is excluded from a sentence span but never removed from the underlying text

steps: embed the query once with the EXISTING V/W0 embedding provider (no new embedding representation)
authority-first search over the EXISTING chunk embeddings: WHERE document_revision_id IN (:eligible) ORDER BY embedding <=> :q
retrieve up to P_seed = K source chunks
map each retrieved chunk to its deterministic AnchorPostings
map those postings to page identities (Lane 1 / Lane 2 pages only)
order seed pages by (retrieved chunk rank, posting start_char, posting end_char, stable page_key)
record the rank-1 seed page as the later path origin

clauses: (a) max cosine between the already-computed query embedding and the EXISTING chunk embeddings of the target page's eligible facets
(b) deterministic link-type priority: exact_anchor before structural

measured_projection_properties.m_max_definition: max over page_key of |{document_revision_id : the page has >= 1 anchor posting in that revision}|, computed over the completed Stage 7C.0 projection
measured_projection_properties.candidate_ceiling_formula: C = (P_seed + B) x M_max x F_max
